metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire during February than October from 2014 to 2017?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Did Cambodia have more active fire during February than October from 2014 to 2017?" This is about fire detection. We need to: 1. Identify a fire detection dataset - MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire (MODIS/006/MOD14A1 or MODIS/006/MYD14A1) 2. Cambodia geometry - we'll use FAO country boundaries 3. Time range: 2014-01-01 to 2018-01-01 (covering 2014-2017) 4. Compare fire activity in February vs October across these years We need to: - Sum fire counts for all February months (2014-2017) vs all October months (2014-2017) - Use the FireMask band which has values 6-9 indicating fire pixels - Count fire pixels for each month comparison Steps: 1. Get Cambodia geometry from FAO/GAUL 2. Get MODIS fire collection for 2014-2017 3. Filter for February (month=2) and October (month=10) 4. Create binary fire mask (values 6-9 = fire) 5. Count fire pixels in each collection 6. Compare totals Need to check: - If collection empty -> try alternative (MYD14A1 if MOD14A1 empty) - If no valid pixels -> C2 - If calculation fails -> C3 - Then compare: Feb > Oct? A: Yes, B: No ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var cambodia = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Cambodia')); var geometry = cambodia.geometry(); var startDate = '2014-01-01'; var endDate = '2018-01-01'; // Cover 2014-2017 inclusive // Helper function to get fire count for a specific month async function getFireCount(month) { var collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(month, month, 'month')) .filterBounds(geometry); // Check if collection is empty var size = collection.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { // Try alternative Aqua MODIS collection collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(month, month, 'month')) .filterBounds(geometry); size = collection.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) return null; } // Create binary fire mask (FireMask values 6-9 = fire) var fireMask = collection.map(function(image) { var fire = image.select('FireMask').gte(6).and(image.select('FireMask').lte(9)); return fire.rename('fire').set('system:time_start', image.get('system:time_start')); }); // Sum all fire detections var totalFire = fireMask.sum(); // Count fire pixels over Cambodia var result = totalFire.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).get('fire'); var count = result.getInfo(); // Check for no valid pixels var pixelCheck = totalFire.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).get('fire').getInfo(); return {count: count, pixelCount: pixelCheck, collectionSize: size}; } // 2. Get fire counts for February (month=2) and October (month=10) var febStats = await getFireCount(2); var octStats = await getFireCount(10); // 3. Check for data issues if (febStats === null || octStats === null) { console.log(`February data: ${febStats ? 'Available' : 'Missing'}`); console.log(`October data: ${octStats ? 'Available' : 'Missing'}`); console.log('C1'); return; } console.log(`February (2014-2017): ${febStats.collectionSize} images, Fire pixels: ${febStats.count}`); console.log(`October (2014-2017): ${octStats.collectionSize} images, Fire pixels: ${octStats.count}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (febStats.pixelCount === 0 || octStats.pixelCount === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (febStats.count === null || octStats.count === null || isNaN(febStats.count) || isNaN(octStats.count)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // 4. Compare and output final answer if (febStats.count > octStats.count) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
